g.text: Gray shading marks wrist occlusion. Hatching marks a protective hold. Gaps mark unavailable estimates. Azimuth is reported from 5° bending.
External clearance ≥ 6.0 cm. Alignment requires position ≤ 3.5 cm and axis error ≤ 3.0° for 1.0 s. The right scale gives axis error.
